name: Table Talk
summary: Conversation starters for friends who want to skip the small talk.
prompts: What tiny decision changed your life more than you expected?
Which place have you visited that still feels vivid?
What skill would you love to become excellent at overnight?
What is a hill you are willing to die on?
Which ordinary day would you happily relive?
What has made you laugh hardest this year?
What is something you changed your mind about recently?
Which fictional world would you visit for one week?
What advice turned out to be completely right?
What are you looking forward to more than anything?
What is a tradition worth starting?
Which song immediately takes you somewhere else?

name: Quick Fire
summary: Fast choices and playful dilemmas for an instant group game.
prompts: Sunrise adventure or midnight adventure?
Always be ten minutes early or ten minutes late?
Give up music or give up films?
Explore the ocean or explore space?
Cook every meal or never cook again?
Relive one great day or erase one bad day?
Be brilliantly lucky or brilliantly skilled?
Know every language or play every instrument?
Only whisper or only shout for a day?
Road trip with no map or holiday with every hour planned?
Pause time or rewind ten seconds?
Host the party or arrive as a guest?
